demand_drivers.title: Mdna (RHP)
demand_drivers.body:
- Business outlook for FY26-27 is positive, with both value and volume expected to grow.
- Increasing formalization of the market and growing acceptance of premium products are seen as offering opportunities for scale and value creation.
- Volatility of bean prices in the short term is likely to impact volumes, but distribution build-up and innovation across B2B and B2C portfolios are expected to drive a strong growth trajectory over the year.

No named project, site or timeline for this expansion is disclosed in this bundle.

risks.title: Risks (RHP)
risks.body:
- Industry-wide risk flagged in MD&A Risks and Challenges; company-level cocoa-price volatility also cited by the Chairman/MD as having resulted in muted value growth and impacted profitability during the year.
- The chocolate segment is dominated by multinationals (Mondelez/Cadbury, Nestlé, Mars) with strong brand equity, distribution and marketing investment.
- The confectionery segment is highly fragmented with a price-sensitive consumer base and high-volume, low-margin dynamics.
- Flagged as an industry risk in MD&A; the Company also separately identifies Supply Chain Risk as critical to its ability to drive growth and operational excellence.
- Most of the Company's debt is short-term debt from capital markets, exposing it to non-availability of external capital from liquidity, interest-rate volatility and macro conditions.
